objectives.objective_text: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of BNT162b3 vaccine in healthy adults aged 18 to 55 years and 56 to 85 years

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Local reactions at the injection site including pain, tenderness, erythema/redness, induration/swelling
endpoints.measurement_method: Subject diary reporting and investigator assessment using FDA Toxicity Grading Scale for Healthy Adult and Adolescent Volunteers Enrolled in Preventive Vaccine Clinical Trials
endpoints.timepoint: Up to 7 days after each immunization (prime and boost)

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Systemic reactions including nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, fatigue, myalgia, arthralgia, chills, loss of appetite, malaise, and fever (≥38°C)
endpoints.measurement_method: Subject diary reporting using FDA Toxicity Grading Scale for Healthy Adult and Adolescent Volunteers Enrolled in Preventive Vaccine Clinical Trials
endpoints.timepoint: Up to 7 days after each immunization (prime and boost)

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Any adverse event with onset date on or after the first administration of IMP or worsened after the first administration of IMP
endpoints.measurement_method: Investigator assessment and reporting using MedDRA coding system, graded by severity (Grade 1-4)
endpoints.timepoint: Up to 28 days after each immunization (prime and boost); up to Visit 7 (approximately 6 months after last immunization)

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Any untoward medical occurrence that results in death, is life-threatening, requires hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization, results in persistent disability/incapacity, is a congenital anomaly or birth defect, or is a medically important event
endpoints.measurement_method: Investigator assessment and reporting within 24 hours of learning of the event
endpoints.timepoint: From Visit 0 (screening) until Visit 7; after Visit 7 only IMP-related SAEs collected through Visit 9

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Specific events including anaphylactic reaction, generalized urticaria, severe unsolicited local events, Grade 4 AEs, systemic SAEs within 7 days, fever >40.0°C, or two subjects with same severe AE within 7 days
endpoints.measurement_method: Investigator assessment according to predefined DLT criteria

objectives.objective_text: To evaluate the immunogenicity of BNT162b3 vaccine in healthy adults

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Serum neutralizing antibody titers against SARS-CoV-2
endpoints.timepoint: Multiple timepoints as specified in Schedule of Activities (baseline, post-prime, post-boost, and follow-up visits)

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Serum binding antibody levels against SARS-CoV-2 antigens
endpoints.timepoint: Multiple timepoints as specified in Schedule of Activities

endpoints.measurement_method: Analysis of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) for T-cell responses
endpoints.timepoint: Multiple timepoints as specified in Schedule of Activities

objectives.objective_text: To explore biomarkers and additional immunological parameters related to BNT162b3 vaccination

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Various biomarkers and immunological parameters for exploratory research purposes
endpoints.measurement_method: Blood sample analysis including up to 5 additional blood draws (up to 200 mL total) for biomarker/immunogenicity research
endpoints.timepoint: Multiple timepoints as specified in Schedule of Activities over approximately 16 months

endpoints.endpoint_definition: Profiling of T-cell receptors (TCRs) in peripheral blood after vaccination
endpoints.measurement_method: Next-generation sequencing of TCRs from blood samples or isolated PBMCs
